Amazon & Etsy Bestseller Product Research Engine — Initial Release

- Instantly generates comprehensive product research reports for any niche on Amazon, Etsy, or both.
- Automatically analyzes bestsellers, pricing, review gaps, search trends, profit margins, and untapped opportunities.
- Includes in-depth review mining, pricing intelligence, Google Trends analysis, keyword and SEO research, profit margin estimation, and sourcing insights.
- Outputs a ranked product opportunity list with detailed recommendations, keyword goldmine, seasonal insights, and supplier suggestions.
- Powered by multiple Apify data actors and advanced workflow automation for e-commerce founders, dropshippers, and sellers.
